name: posable body figure measured with calipers (template)
source: Fill with caliper measurements of the figure in mm. Each segment is modelled as an elliptic frustum (uniform density); the result is scaled to height_m / mass_kg.
notes: w = width (left-right), d = depth (front-back) at the proximal (0) and distal (1) ends, all in mm on the figure. Values here are placeholders (roughly human proportions), not a real measurement. head len = vertex to cervicale; trunk len = cervicale to hip joint height (may be left as measured).
